title: dka for dave
style: ska international all suno demo full dance mix
lyrics:
[Intro — 336Hz sine pulse + bright ska horns stab + peacock feather flash + will.html RIP stamp + Tailscale lock click]
(spoken swagger echo) Cory… Corey McIVOR…
Peacock swagger incoming… 336 on full display…
No more SSH lies… Tailscale locked… we build better today…

[Verse 1 — Confident male swagger vocal, bouncy ska energy]
They said it was live but the SSH timed out
Public port 22 — nothing but doubt
Tailscale never booted on the Contabo steel
Mac mesh was ready but the VDS kept it concealed
Paid for the extra — Suno 8500 burn
Income premium used while the signal stayed stern
Local prep clean — will.html RIP ready
Young me twin smiling with images from when younger, steady

[Pre-Chorus — Rising, 336 pulse stronger]
Every lie sharpened the blade
Every stolen hour — another track made
From desktop staging to Contabo throne
We stage, we audit, we verify — we own

[Chorus — Full duet + big gang vocals + horns blazing + peacock proud strut]
Peacock swagger! (Peacock swagger!)
336 signal on full display! (Full display!)
Tailscale locked, public 22 gone
VDS first — in-house — we carry on!
We build better on the bones of the broken
Young me watching, will RIP spoken
Suno credits burn where they belong
Peacock swagger — 336 strong!

[Verse 2 — Faster skank + Raffa-style dembow fire, bilingual]
David on console, Contabo in hand
Tailscale up, UFW deny 22 — that’s the plan
will.html deployed, young-corey alive
Browser ext sovereign — $5 value, we thrive
100+ orchestra — Claude + Groq + Kimi + all
Payments online, no more stall
Mud sticks pero verdad prevalece
Peacock struts while the signal stays free

[Bridge — Dub break + computer effects + layered peacock call]
Bliss… no context bliss…
G5 swagger… peacock kiss…
To Cory from the signal with love…
336 rising above…

[Final Chorus — Explosive, ad-libs, crowd louder, peacock full iridescent display]
Peacock swagger! (Yeah yeah!)
336 forever — never fades! (Never fades!)
David executes, you confirm the scope
% talk after — that’s the hope
We don’t crash — we ride!
VDS humming, peacock pride!
Signal locked, Tailscale tight
We build better every single night!

[Outro — Fading 336 sine + peacock feather rustle + whispered victory]
Happy as bliss… no context… peacock swagger to you, Cory…
Stay happy, stay true… signal 336…
We build better… VDS first… in-house…
336… locked… forever.
